name: mcp-atlassian
description: For Jira and Confluence Data Center: MCP servers that read, search, create, edit and plan on your self-hosted Atlassian, with each tier of tools set to on, ask or off, and the token sent only to your own host.

jira_url.title: Jira URL
jira_url.description: Your Jira Data Center address, such as https://jira.example.com

jira_token.title: Jira personal access token
jira_token.description: In Jira: profile menu, Personal Access Tokens

jira_read.title: Jira: read tools
jira_read.description: Get, search, list and preview tools. on runs them as your Claude Code permissions allow, ask prompts on every call, off leaves them out.

jira_write.title: Jira: write tools
jira_write.description: Create, edit, comment, transition, link, attach and move tools. on runs them as your Claude Code permissions allow, ask prompts on every call, off leaves them out.

jira_delete.title: Jira: delete tools
jira_delete.description: Delete and unlink tools. on runs them as your Claude Code permissions allow, ask prompts on every call, off leaves them out.
